ostenya.lead: The United States of Ostanya (USO) is a transoceanic military, technological, and economic superpower occupying a vast continent west of Avren. As the champion of maritime free trade and cutting-edge aerospace standards, Ostanya commands nuclear supercarrier strike groups and operates the ARGUS satellite constellation, projecting undisputed naval and orbital presence. A close strategic partner of [[elonya]], Ostanya declared 'freedom of navigation patrols' in the Kalyon Sea during the [[kriz]], dispatching guided missile cruisers and nuclear attack submarines to the periphery.
sections: Global doctrine and naval supremacy

Ostanyan security doctrine centers upon keeping international sea lanes and strategic chokepoints open. Megacorporations like 'Iron Dome Aerospace' and 'General Dynamics-Osten' supply fifth-generation stealth fighters and precision munitions worldwide.
Posture during the SKYFORTRESS-4 Crisis

Anataria's independent orbital program at [[sarpburun]] was labeled by Ostanya as an uncontrolled escalation threatening its ally Elonia. While avoiding formal involvement in the declaration of war, Ostanya has supplied real-time reconnaissance feeds to the Elonian Navy.

ursya.title: Ursian Federation
ursya.desc: Continental superpower spanning northern tundras with vast heavy industry and nuclear arsenals.
ursya.lead: The Ursian Federation is a vast continental superpower spanning the frozen tundras, taiga, and interior mountain ranges northeast of Avren. Holding the world's largest landmass and colossal energy reserves, Ursya is recognized for heavy metallurgy, rocket propulsion, and strategic deterrence. Historically maintaining balanced defense ties with [[anatarya]], Ursya licensed the engine designs and baseline telemetry for Anataria's workhorse [[k4-boran]] strike jets and heavy space launch stages.
facts: K-4 Boran jet engines · Heavy rocket stages
sections: Aerospace and propulsion heritage

Ursian design philosophy emphasizes rugged airframes and high-output engines capable of austere operations. State combines like 'Sever-Aviatsiya' produce some of the most potent solid and liquid rocket boosters in existence.
Geopolitical counterweight in the crisis

Viewing Ostanyan-Elonian naval maneuvers as an encirclement of southern flanks, Ursya has provided Anataria with passive electronic counter-reconnaissance components to balance Western coalition pressure.

huaxia.title: People's Republic of Huaxia
huaxia.desc: Eastern manufacturing, microelectronics, and orbital component titan.
huaxia.lead: The People's Republic of Huaxia is an eastern industrial titan and demographic heavyweight serving as the primary foundry of global electronics. Producing the lion's share of high-purity silicon wafers, rare earth minerals, and solar array wafers, Huaxia supplied the dense photovoltaic cells and optical beam splitters utilized on [[skyfortress-4]].
sections: Semiconductor and materials leverage
Both Anataria and Elonia rely on Huaxia's semiconductor fabrication plants for radar chips and signal processors, giving Huaxia quiet commercial leverage over regional military modernization.
Commercial neutrality in the conflict
Calling for maritime stability in the Kalyon Sea, Huaxia maintains open trade with all belligerents while honoring commercial shipments of dual-use telecommunication components.

anasas.title: ANASAS Aerospace
anasas.desc: Anataria Aerospace Industries; the nation's premier aircraft and launch system prime contractor.
anasas.lead: ANASAS (Anataria Aerospace Industries) is the industrial cornerstone of [[anatarya]]'s sovereignty in the skies and orbital space. Founded following historical foreign arms embargoes, the company is the lead integrator of the [[k21-kaan]] 5th-generation stealth fighter, the [[simsek-iii]] space launch vehicle, and the primary bus structures for the [[skyfortress-4]] satellite constellation.
sections: Origin and self-reliance doctrine
Formed in response to exterior supply cutoffs, ANASAS advanced from licensed component overhauls to carbon-composite airframe manufacturing and cleanroom space integration.
Fifth-generation fighter engineering
With the K-21 program, ANASAS joined an elite handful of aerospace firms capable of constructing super-cruising stealth fighters with internal weapons bays.

baykut.title: Baykut Defense Technologies
baykut.desc: Pioneer of autonomous combat drones, AI flight algorithms, and unmanned stealth aircraft.
baykut.lead: Baykut Defense Technologies is a world-renowned [[anatarya]] defense firm pioneering armed unmanned aerial vehicles (UCAVs) and autonomous combat systems. Producing the iconic [[bayrak-t2]] tactical drone, the twin-turboprop [[akin-3]] heavy strike drone, and the [[al-elma]] supersonic unmanned stealth jet, Baykut has fundamentally transformed modern maritime and aerial warfare doctrines.
facts: Autonomous flight · Machine vision · Loyal wingman swarming
sections: Agile innovation and software independence
Operating free of traditional bureaucratic drag, Baykut builds mission avionics, flight-control software, and sensor fusion algorithms in-house, eliminating dependency on foreign electronics.
Tactical impact in the 2036 Crisis
During the Kalyon Sea tensions, relentless patrols by Baykut drones tracked Elonian naval detachments around the clock, providing real-time target vectors to coastal batteries.

sarpsan.title: SARPSAN Electronics
sarpsan.desc: National designer of phased-array radars, electronic warfare suites, and electro-optical sensors.
sarpsan.lead: SARPSAN (Sarpburun Defense Electronics) is the premier electronic warfare and radar design house for the [[anatarya]] Armed Forces. It designs the phased-array surveillance radars at [[sarpburun-radar-istasyonu]], the nose-mounted AESA radar for the [[k21-kaan]], and optical targeting pods deployed across unmanned fleets.
sections: Jam-resistant signal engineering
SARPSAN developed the agile frequency-hopping waveforms that counter Elonian jamming attempts originating from the AIGAION battle group.
Analysis of File 94-117
In 2036, SARPSAN laboratories conducted the definitive spectral extraction of the anomalous 243.0 MHz transmission associated with [[dosya-94-117]].

korsan.title: KORSAN Missile Systems
korsan.desc: Manufacturer of solid rocket motors, air defense interceptors, and precision smart munitions.
korsan.lead: KORSAN (Kor Munitions & Rocket Systems) is the primary rocket propulsion and guided ordnance contractor in [[anatarya]]. It manufactures interceptors for the [[kalkan-hss]] system, solid-propellant booster stages for the [[simsek-iii]] space rocket, and laser-guided micro-munitions for the [[bayrak-t2]] fleet.
facts: Kalkan interceptor missiles · MAM precision glide munitions
sections: Solid propellant breakthrough
By mastering advanced composite propellants, KORSAN enabled high-burn-rate rocket motors crucial for both rapid-climb air defense and orbital satellite insertion.

k21-kaan.title: K-21 KAAN
k21-kaan.desc: Anataria’s twin-engine, low-observable 5th-generation national combat stealth fighter.
k21-kaan.lead: The K-21 KAAN is a twin-engine, super-cruising, low-observable (stealth) 5th-generation air superiority and deep strike fighter developed by [[anasas]] for the [[anatarya]] Air Force. Featuring internal weapons bays, an advanced [[sarpsan]] AESA radar, and an integrated helmet-mounted cueing system, the KAAN replaces legacy [[k4-boran]] aircraft. During the 2036 [[kriz]], initial operational prototypes were mobilized at Arkent Air Base, conducting deterrent combat patrols over Sarpburun and the Kalyon Sea.
facts: SARPSAN Nose AESA Radar · Electro-Optical Targeting (EOTS)
Internal fuselage and lateral stations (Stealth configuration)
sections: Stealth architecture and design
Engineered to penetrate dense enemy radar networks undetected, the KAAN incorporates radar-absorbent composite skin, angled engine intakes, and serrated bay doors to minimize radar cross-section.
Combat debut in the 2036 Crisis

Following the forward deployment of the Elonian AIGAION frigate, two K-21 prototypes scrambled from Arkent on combat air patrol. Inability of Elonian radars to acquire weapons-grade locks proved pivotal in checking coalition escalation.
In the game

The K-21 KAAN is the squadron’s elite aircraft and is available only to [[hancer]] members of the eighth rank, Wing Commander. It is called from HAS 4 (bay DG_4) of [[sarpburun-air-base]] with a 600-second cooldown and carries tail number 21-001. Two engines give 152.6 kN of military thrust and 258.8 kN with afterburner on a 24-tonne airframe, which is enough to exceed the speed of sound without afterburner (about Mach 1.3 at military power and 1.8 with afterburner). The hull has 900 HP and each wing 320 HP.

Three internal bays hold four KS-9 missiles: one in each side bay and two in the main bay; the doors open for about 0.4 seconds before launch and close one second after the last missile is gone. A 20 mm cannon with 510 rounds fires through a door in the right wing root and 30 flares are carried.
Stealth signature

The KAAN has a radar signature of 0.25 and an infrared signature of 0.6 relative to the K-16. The [[frost-acv]] mast sees it only at 1,000 studs instead of 4,000, and KS-9 seekers acquire it at 3,300 studs instead of 5,500. The signature rises to full while a bay or gun door is open and for two seconds afterwards, and the infrared signature rises to full with the afterburner lit. The cockpit display shows STEALTH or VISIBLE accordingly. Losing one engine halves the thrust and turns the nose toward the dead engine.

bayrak-t2.title: BAYRAK-T2
bayrak-t2.desc: Anataria’s 27-hour endurance tactical armed reconnaissance drone system.
bayrak-t2.lead: The BAYRAK-T2 is a medium-altitude long-endurance (MALE) tactical unmanned combat aerial vehicle developed by [[baykut]] Defense. Characterized by its inverted V-tail, redundant avionics, and autonomous triple-redundant flight control, the T2 carries four laser-guided smart micro-munitions engineered by [[korsan]]. Throughout the 2036 [[kriz]], T2 squadrons maintained relentless day-and-night surveillance over the Kalyon Sea and the Istara Strait.
sections: Maritime reconnaissance reach

Featuring faint acoustic and infrared signatures, the T2 loiters above sea lanes for over a day without risking pilot life, identifying surface vessels from 40 kilometers away via SARPSAN optical suites.
Counter-blockade operations
The transit vectors of the AIGAION battle group were continuously relayed by orbiting T2s, frustrating Elonian attempts to establish covert amphibious footholds.

akin-3.title: AKIN-3
akin-3.desc: Twin-turboprop heavy strategic strike UCAV capable of launching standoff cruise missiles.
akin-3.lead: The AKIN-3 is a high-altitude long-endurance (HALE) twin-turboprop heavy strike unmanned aerial vehicle developed by [[baykut]] Defense. Boasting an unprecedented 1,500 kg payload capacity comparable to light attack jets, the AKIN-3 features a nose AESA radar, satellite communications link, and carriage capability for standoff cruise missiles.
sections: Standoff strike potential

The AKIN-3 can carry long-range precision cruise missiles under its heavy inboard pylons, allowing it to neutralize high-value coastal targets well beyond the engagement envelope of enemy surface-to-air missiles.
Direct space telemetry tie-in
Through an onboard steerable dish antenna, the platform routes mission data directly through the [[skyfortress-4]] orbital relay for real-time strategic battle management.

al-elma.title: AL-ELMA K-01
al-elma.desc: AI-driven supersonic unmanned stealth combat fighter jet.
al-elma.lead: The AL-ELMA K-01 is a single-engine supersonic unmanned combat stealth fighter (UCAV-Jet) engineered by [[baykut]] Defense. Designed with low-observable canards, radar-absorbent materials, and an aggressive flight envelope, AL-ELMA is crafted for autonomous air-to-air dogfighting, air defense suppression (SEAD), and cooperative 'loyal wingman' operations alongside the manned [[k21-kaan]].
facts: Loyal wingman to K-21 KAAN · Autonomous dogfighting
Conventional runways and short-deck amphibious carriers
sections: Next-generation unmanned air combat
Unconstrained by human G-force limits, AL-ELMA executes instantaneous high-rate turns directed by machine learning algorithms that outpace human pilot reaction times.
Observation during the 2036 Crisis
Civilian and radar monitors recorded formation flights between a K-21 KAAN and an AL-ELMA airframe departing Arkent for coastal patrol, signaling a revolution in regional air warfare.
Location

Pelagos Station sits on an isolated rocky islet at the western edge of the disputed Kalyon chain. A concrete breakwater protects a small boat jetty capable of handling high-speed interceptor craft in heavy swells.
Duties
Station personnel monitor fishing fleets, report unauthorized Anatarian naval movements across maritime median lines, and relay real-time visual feeds to Lerya headquarters.
Flashpoint proximity
The outpost faces Anatarian border patrol stations across narrow nautical channels, leading to frequent radio exchanges and tense close encounters between patrol cutters.
pelagos-karakolu.title: Pelagos Forward Coast Guard Station
pelagos-karakolu.lead: A forward monitoring outpost and rapid-interception patrol boat station operated by Elonia on the western approaches to the Kalyon Islands.
pelagos-karakolu.desc: Elonia's forward coast guard outpost on the western approach to the Kalyon Islands.

sections: History

During the maritime confrontation of November 2026, known as 'Kalyon naval clash', naval units from both sides exchanged gunfire in adverse weather, resulting in lost vessels and casualties. Two years later, neutral maritime delegations established this beacon upon a central reef as both a navigational aid and an eternal memorial.
Memorial plaque

A bronze register affixed to the granite pedestal lists the names of sailors lost from both nations. The revolving beacon warns vessels away from jagged underwater reefs while serving as a quiet reminder of the human cost of conflict.
Annual observance
Every November 15, civilian fishing flotillas from both Elonia and Anataria lay floral wreaths upon the surrounding waters, marking a solemn interlude amid ongoing geopolitical rivalries.
kara-kasim-feneri.title: Kalyon Mariners' Memorial Lighthouse
kara-kasim-feneri.lead: A navigational beacon and memorial lighthouse erected in remembrance of the naval casualties of the 2026 Kalyon Sea skirmish.
kara-kasim-feneri.desc: A memorial lighthouse for sailors lost in the 2026 Kalyon naval clash.

sections: Emplacement and layout

The KOR-KALKAN complex comprises reinforced underground silos, mobile vertical launch containers, and SARPSAN fire-control radars. The battery can engage up to 16 airborne targets simultaneously, including stealth missiles and low-altitude cruise missiles.
Defense of SKYFORTRESS-4

The site's primary mission is creating an umbrella over the SKYFORTRESS-4 launch pads and satellite uplink stations. During the naval buildup, the battery maintained around-the-clock radar lock tracking approaching Elonian strike wings.
Deterrent envelope
The long engagement envelope reaching into the Kalyon Sea prevents hostile attack aircraft from releasing standoff precision munitions without being targeted.
kor-kalkan-bataryasi.title: Kalyon Air Defense & Missile Battery (KOR-KALKAN)
kor-kalkan-bataryasi.lead: A long-range surface-to-air missile installation operated by Anataria, safeguarding Sarpburun airspace and SKYFORTRESS-4 from standoff aerial and missile strikes.
kor-kalkan-bataryasi.desc: A long-range air defense battery guarding SKYFORTRESS-4 and Sarpburun airspace.

sections: Overview

Lerya 5th Tactical Jet Base is the central airfield defending Elonia's political center and outlying island outposts in the Kalyon Sea. Its coastal location enables aircraft to climb out over water immediately upon takeoff.
Tactical duties

Fighter-bombers and interceptors stationed at the base conduct routine sovereignty sweeps over the disputed Kalyon Islands. Aerial scrambles and close encounters with Anatarian fighters typically originate from this installation.
Defenses

The perimeter is ringed with Avren Union-standard surface-to-air missile sites. Because it lies within direct line-of-sight of Anataria's [[sarpburun-radar]], aircraft departing Lerya are tracked from rotation.
lerya-jet-ussu.title: Lerya 5th Tactical Jet Base (Pelican)
lerya-jet-ussu.lead: The Republic of Elonia's primary tactical air base on the Kalyon coast, conducting island air patrols and coastal air defense.
lerya-jet-ussu.desc: Elonia's tactical air base on the Kalyon coast.

sections: Engineering and structure

Completed in 2028 across the narrow marine narrows separating Sarpburun from the mainland, the bridge is designed to withstand severe sea gales and seismic tremors. Its double-track railway conveys heavy rocket stages and cryogenic propellant convoys to [[skyfortress-4]].
Fortification

Both anchor towers feature anti-aircraft weapon pods and GPS/datalink decoy emitters. A rapid aerosol smoke screening system can shroud the deck from precision laser and electro-optical weapon seekers.
Vulnerability

Because the peninsula has no other road connection to the mainland, the Sarp Gate bridge is a critical single point of failure; its loss would isolate all personnel and defense units stationed at SKYFORTRESS-4.
sarp-gecidi.title: Sarpburun Gate Suspension Bridge
sarp-gecidi.lead: The strategic heavy suspension bridge and fortified causeway linking the Sarpburun Peninsula to mainland Anataria; the lifeline of SKYFORTRESS-4 logistics.
sarp-gecidi.desc: A fortified bridge and land crossing connecting the Sarpburun Peninsula to mainland Anataria.

sections: Strategic position

The İstara Strait is the only nautical transit canal linking the Northern Sea with the Inner Sea. The garrison occupies historical fortress promontories modernized with radar domes, thermal cameras, and hardened underground bunkers.
Maritime traffic management

All commercial vessels and naval contingents entering the strait must report to the garrison's Vessel Traffic Service. In the event of military conflict, the garrison holds legal authority to enforce maritime interdiction.
Defensive firepower
Truck-mounted KOR-SAN coastal defense missile launchers deployed along the heights can engage hostile naval targets up to 180 km away, effectively denying passage to unauthorized foreign warships.
istara-garnizonu.title: İstara Strait Coastal Defense Garrison
istara-garnizonu.lead: An Anatarian coastal defense garrison equipped with shore-to-ship missiles and surface surveillance radars guarding maritime transit through the İstara Strait.
istara-garnizonu.desc: Anatarian coastal defense garrison controlling the Istara Strait.
facts: [[korsan]] Atmaca-K Coastal Defense Missiles, 76 mm Coastal Guns
İstara Vessel Traffic Service Radar Tower

sections: Facility structure

Pelagos Fleet Base is sheltered within the deep, natural harbor of Lerya Bay. Outer breakwaters are fortified with coastal gun emplacements and torpedo tubes. The compound includes repair drydocks, ammunition magazines, and the naval command staff headquarters.
Aigaion task group

Elonia's flagship guided missile frigate [[aigaion]] and accompanying missile corvettes are homeported here. Munitions staging and pre-deployment logistics for the SKYFORTRESS-4 operation were completed at this waterfront.
Strategic impact
By projecting sea power through narrow nautical choke points in the Kalyon Sea, the base maintains leverage over commercial shipping lines heading toward Anatarian ports.
lerya-deniz-ussu.title: Lerya Naval Headquarters & Pelagos Fleet Base
lerya-deniz-ussu.lead: The primary naval operating base, drydock shipyard, and frigate flotilla station for the Republic of Elonia Navy in the Kalyon Sea.
lerya-deniz-ussu.desc: The Elonian navy's principal Kalyon Sea operating base.
facts: 1st Frigate Flotilla, Kalyon Fast Attack Craft Division

sections: Infrastructure and layout

Constructed at the foothill plateau 35 km west of Arkent, the 1st Main Jet Base is Anataria's most fortified air station, featuring underground hardened aircraft shelters, bomb-proof munitions depots, and autonomous fuel pipeline galleries. The dual parallel runways connect directly to adjacent hardened highway landing strips.
Stationed wings

The base hosts the elite core of Anataria's tactical air fleet. The 101st 'Karakartal' Squadron operates the frontline [[k21-kaan]] 5th-generation stealth fighters, alongside [[k16-alaz]] interceptors maintaining combat air patrols over Sarpburun and Kalyon. Autonomous operational trials for [[baykut]]'s [[al-elma]] unmanned fighter are also managed from this site.
Operational role

In high-readiness scenarios, interceptors from Arkent can scramble and reach Sarpburun airspace in under 6 minutes. Air operations are centrally coordinated via the underground Arkent Air Operations Center.
arkent-jet-ussu.title: Arkent 1st Main Jet Base Command (Karakartal)
arkent-jet-ussu.lead: The premier fighter air base defending Anataria's capital and western operational theater, home to K-21 KAAN, K16-Alaz, and unmanned combat fighter squadrons.
arkent-jet-ussu.desc: The main fighter base for Anataria's capital defense and western air operations.
facts: 101st Karakartal Squadron ([[k21-kaan]]), 132nd Dagger Squadron ([[k16-alaz]]), 14th Unmanned Fighter Squadron ([[al-elma]])

sections: Overview

SARP-RAD stands atop the highest elevation of the Sarpburun Peninsula. Commissioned in 2031 to protect Anataria's western territorial boundary and the [[skyfortress-4]] spaceport against hostile air, surface, and ballistic missile threats, its 3D AESA antenna and advanced digital signal processors provide over-the-horizon tracking of sea-skimming targets.
Electronic warfare capabilities

Beyond surveillance, the installation houses high-power electronic support measures (ESM) and electronic attack (EA) suites capable of degrading and jamming [[elonya]] airborne reconnaissance platforms and GPS/datalink guidance networks along the disputed boundary.
Tactical significance

During the SKYFORTRESS-4 crisis, SARP-RAD was the first terrestrial radar station to detect the tactical approach of the [[aigaion]] frigate battle group. Target track data is fused and transmitted directly to [[k21-kaan]] fighters at [[arkent-jet-ussu]] and [[kor-kalkan-bataryasi]].
sarpburun-radar.title: Sarpburun Early Warning Radar Complex (SARP-RAD)
sarpburun-radar.lead: An active electronically scanned array (AESA) early warning and electronic warfare complex deployed on the northern crest of the Sarpburun Peninsula, monitoring a 600 km radius across the Kalyon Sea and Avren airspace.
sarpburun-radar.desc: An early warning radar and electronic warfare complex on Sarpburun's northern ridge.

altai-mbt.title: ALTAI MBT
altai-mbt.desc: Heavy main battle tank of the 27th Iron Fist Mechanized Infantry Regiment.
altai-mbt.lead: The ALTAI MBT (lore name Altay) is the heavy main battle tank of [[demir-iz]], modeled on the Altay T1. It is a four-man tank with a 120 mm smoothbore gun, an active protection system and a dedicated driver station, and only Iron Fist crews may drive it.
facts: 7.62 mm coaxial machine gun · 12.7 mm SARP remote weapon station
AKKOR active protection · ERA skirts · smoke launchers
sections: Role

The ALTAI is the heavy and elite armored asset of the Iron Fist regiment. It is not issued to the [[sarp-muhafiz]] company, whose armored response element uses the [[kaya-zma]] instead. The tank has no passenger seats.
Crew stations

The crew boards through hatches. The driver enters through his own hatch, the gunner and commander share the commander’s hatch (the first to board becomes the gunner) and the loader has a separate hatch.

Driver: with the hatch open the driver sits turned out with head and shoulders exposed. With the hatch closed he works from a driver station with three fixed periscopes, a selectable camera view (automatic, front, left, right, rear) with rear distance lines at 1.5, 3 and 6 m, a digital instrument display and a backup analog gauge.

Gunner: fires the main gun and coaxial machine gun through an MFD display with APFSDS, HE and coaxial selection, thermal imaging, zoom and a laser rangefinder.

Commander: a 360° cupola with an independent panoramic sight, a SARP view, a 360° camera mode and a gunner repeater. The panoramic sight can hand its target to the turret (hunter-killer) and the commander also controls smoke.

Loader: working from his own hatch he operates a 7.62 mm machine gun when the hatch is open, and halves the main gun reload time. With no loader aboard, reloading takes twice as long.

In the latest workshop revision of 13 November the control layout is being changed so that the driver also fires the main gun and the coaxial machine gun, while the gunner operates the 12.7 mm SARP station; see [[leopard-2a4-t1]] for the same arrangement.
Protection and survivability

Armor values follow the real Altay T1: turret front 650 mm, hull front 550 mm, sides 90 mm, ERA-equipped skirts 140 mm, rear 40 mm and roof 30 mm.

The AKKOR active protection system carries two charges on each side. It engages only rounds that will actually hit the tank, defeating projectiles of 30 mm and above at a range of 25 studs, and it never engages the tank’s own crew’s shots. Two smoke salvos last about 20 seconds each. AKKOR charges and smoke are restored only by hull repair or at a resupply point.

The ammunition compartment at the back of the turret is fitted with blow-off panels: if it detonates the panels fly off and the crew survives. A detonation of the hull ammunition destroys the tank and the turret is thrown clear.
Mobility

On roads the ALTAI reaches 64 studs per second (65 km/h) and 45 off-road; reverse is limited to 30. It accelerates from zero to 32 km/h in 6.5 seconds and to 90 percent of top speed in about 24 seconds. The tracked hull pivots in place at 24° per second and the turn rate falls to about 8° per second at top speed. The road surface is read from the terrain material.
Variants and markings

Two variants exist: the standard version in flat NATO green with tactical number 27-101, and a Woodland version in a three-color NATO camouflage with number 27-102. The turret carries the Iron Fist insignia and tactical number on each side and the Anataria flag on the rear.
Availability in the game

The ALTAI is called from Iron Fist vehicle bays IF_1 and IF_2 at the garrison motor pool and requires the fifth rank (Tank Commander). A tank can be recalled only after a 600-second cooldown. See [[vehicle-bays]] and [[divisions-and-ranks]].

leopard-2a4-t1.title: Leopard 2A4 T1
leopard-2a4-t1.desc: Up-armored Leopard 2A4 in woodland camouflage; second tank of the 27th Iron Fist.
leopard-2a4-t1.lead: The Leopard 2A4 T1 is the second main battle tank of [[demir-iz]], a Leopard 2A4 with the T1 reactive-passive add-on armor package, painted in a three-color woodland camouflage. It serves alongside the heavier [[altai-mbt]]. Its characteristics follow the real vehicle rather than being balanced against the Altay.
facts: 42 rounds: 15 in the turret ready rack, 27 in the hull
sections: Role

The Leopard 2A4 T1 gives the Iron Fist regiment a second tank. The ALTAI remains the heavy, elite choice; the Leopard is the regiment’s more conventional armored platform. As of 13 November it exists in the vehicle workshop only; moving it into the main game is a separate step.
Crew layout

The Leopard introduces a layout in which one player can operate the whole tank. The driver steers and also fires the main gun and the coaxial MG3, switching between the driving periscopes and the gunner’s sight with a key. The gunner works the loader’s-hatch MG3 from an open mount and must open the hatch to use it. The commander has the PERI-R17 periscope and a repeater of the gunner’s EMES-15 sight and also controls smoke. The loader halves the reload time but has no weapon of his own.

The Leopard does not have the 360° camera ring or the data-link NET page, because the real 2A4 T1 does not have them.
Armor and the T1 package

Open-source estimates put the 2A4 turret front near 590 mm and the hull front near 450 mm against kinetic energy rounds. The T1 package adds composite box modules to the turret front, the gun shield and the turret sides, and slat cage armor along the rear half of the turret and behind the engine deck. The cage armor usually spoils shaped-charge hits from RPGs and similar weapons. The Leopard has no active protection system.
Ammunition and vulnerability

The Leopard carries its 42 rounds as in the real tank: 15 in the turret bustle on the left, protected by blow-off panels, and 27 in a hull magazine to the left of the driver. The hull magazine is unprotected, so a penetration that ignites it destroys the tank. The ready rack is used first; once it is empty, reloading from the hull is slower (12 seconds with a loader, 20 seconds without).
Appearance

The turret front is the 2A4’s upright, flat design, distinct from the arrowhead wedge modules of the Altay, and the T1 box modules are bolted on top. The woodland camouflage uses large irregular blotches of green, brown and black. The regiment insignia and number 27-201 appear on the turret sides.

sentinel-lpv.title: Sentinel LPV
sentinel-lpv.desc: Unarmed light patrol vehicle of the 4th Sarp Guard Company.
sentinel-lpv.lead: The Sentinel LPV (Light Patrol Vehicle) is an unarmed, Defender-110-style patrol car used by every member of the [[sarp-muhafiz]] company. It carries a driver and six passengers and is the everyday vehicle of facility security around [[skyfortress-4]].
sections: Role
The Sentinel is a utility vehicle for patrols, escorts and moving guards around the facility. Any Sarp Guard member can drive it; the six passenger seats are open to everyone.
Boarding and controls

Boarding is by door: the front left door is the driver’s, the front right door the front passenger’s, the rear doors give access to a three-seat bench and the tailgate to two seats facing each other. Leaving the vehicle puts the passenger outside the same door, or the next one if it is blocked, or on the roof as a last resort.

Keys: L roof beacon, K siren, H horn (held), B headlights, X engine off, C change seat, F exit. The driver’s hands rest on the wheel, which turns four times the angle of the front wheels.
Appearance
The body is navy blue with a silver-gray roof and sills and a white stripe. The front doors carry the unit insignia, the rear sides the Anataria flag, and the hood and spare tire read SARP GUARD.
Availability in the game
Sarp Guard bays SG_1 and SG_3 to SG_6 issue the Sentinel without a rank requirement, cooldown or limit on numbers. See [[vehicle-bays]].

taurus-mtv.title: Taurus MTV
taurus-mtv.desc: Family of armored multirole tactical vehicles in armed, communications and cargo versions.
taurus-mtv.lead: The Taurus MTV (Multi-role Tactical Vehicle) is a family of armored Humvee-style vehicles built on a common chassis with interchangeable bodies. Three versions serve three different units: the armed MTV-A with [[demir-iz]], the communications MTV-C with [[kuzey-isaret]] and the cargo MTV-L with [[doruk-ikmal]].
sections: MTV-A

The armed version of [[demir-iz]]: a four-door armored vehicle with an open roof turret carrying a shielded 12.7 mm heavy machine gun. The gunner stands, aims with the mouse and reloads with R. An Iron Fist member who boards through the rear door becomes the gunner if the position is free. Hull strength is 650 HP and the armor is 14, 12, 10 and 8 mm; the turret shield is 12 mm thick and stops 7.62 mm rounds while leaving the gunner’s head exposed.
MTV-C

The communications version of [[kuzey-isaret]]: two doors, an unarmed radio cabin and room for two staff in the rear. Hull strength 550 HP, armor 12, 10, 8 and 6 mm. The unit’s heavier command vehicle is the [[frost-acv]].
MTV-L

The cargo version of [[doruk-ikmal]]: two doors and a tarpaulin-covered load bed through which four people can be carried. Hull strength 500 HP, armor 12, 6, 6 and 6 mm; the side of the load bed is open to 7.62 mm fire.
Appearance and crews

All versions are painted dark military green, with the unit insignia on the front doors, the Anataria flag on the rear sides and an MTV-A/C/L stencil beside the hood. Only the owning unit’s members can drive; the passenger seats are open to everyone. The keys are H horn, B headlights, X engine off, C change seat and F exit.
Availability in the game
Iron Fist bays IF_3 and IF_4 issue the MTV-A without limit or cooldown at the first rank. See [[vehicle-bays]].

frost-acv.title: Frost ACV
frost-acv.desc: Armored command vehicle with a deployable sensor mast of the 6th Northern Signal Battalion.
frost-acv.lead: The Frost ACV (Armored Command Vehicle) is a 4×4 MRAP-class command vehicle of [[kuzey-isaret]]. It stops, raises a telescopic sensor mast, detects aircraft and ground vehicles and shares those contacts by data link with friendly vehicle displays. The name is the English form of the Turkish “Ayaz”.
facts: 12.7 mm remote weapon station on the roof
About 95 studs per second on road · 60 off-road
sections: Role

The Frost gives the signals battalion an armored, armed command post. The commander sits at the sensor station, the gunner works the remote weapon from inside the vehicle and the battalion’s two staff members ride in the rear.
Sensor mast

The mast has three telescopic stages and carries a rotating radar dome, a day and thermal camera head and a short antenna. It can be raised only when the vehicle is almost stopped; if the vehicle moves faster than 4 studs per second the mast lowers automatically with a MAST AUTO-STOW warning. Damage to the mast module shuts the sensor down until it is repaired.

With the mast up the vehicle sees aircraft, hostile drones and missiles to 4,000 studs and ground vehicles to 1,000 studs, provided there is a clear line of sight. Low-observable aircraft such as the [[k21-kaan]] are detected much later: the KAAN’s radar signature of 0.25 shortens the detection range to about 1,000 studs.
Data link

The Frost merges its contacts with those of any other Frost whose mast is up and writes them to a shared data link. Contacts appear only on vehicle displays: on the commander’s RADAR and CAM pages, on the HSD page of the [[k16-alaz]] and on the NET page of the [[altai-mbt]] commander’s display. Infantry on foot see nothing.
Availability in the game
The Frost is called from the Northern Signal garage (bay NS_1), a single-bay garage at the north end of the headquarters courtyard, at the first rank with a 300-second cooldown. See [[vehicle-bays]].

dolphin-rhib.title: Dolphin RHIB
dolphin-rhib.desc: Rigid-hull inflatable boat of the 3rd Coast Guard Command.
dolphin-rhib.lead: The Dolphin RHIB is the smallest vessel of the [[coast-guard-command]], a rigid-hull inflatable boat about 30 studs long used for patrols, boarding and rescue in the Rockcove bay and the sea beyond. Four boats, CG-3R1 to CG-3R4, are based at the station.
sections: Description

Dark gray inflatable collar, white hull, an open console with a windscreen and wheel, jockey seats, a bow machine gun mount, a rear frame with radar and light and two outboard motors. The OPV [[northwind-opv]] carries one Dolphin in its stern ramp.
Availability in the game
The Dolphin is called from berths CG_1 to CG_4 on the pontoon at the head of the bay. It needs the first rank and has no cooldown. See [[vehicle-bays]] and [[rockcove-station]].

seagull-fpb.title: Seagull FPB
seagull-fpb.desc: Fast patrol boat of the 3rd Coast Guard Command.
seagull-fpb.lead: The Seagull-class fast patrol boat is the mid-size vessel of the [[coast-guard-command]], about 75 studs long with a deep-V hull, an enclosed bridge and a 12.7 mm remote-controlled weapon at the bow. Three boats, CG-331 to CG-333, are based at Rockcove.
sections: Description

The enclosed bridge has two seats, a console and displays and can be entered, and a lower cabin holds two bunks and a table. A mast carries the radar and navigation lights, and an open aft deck has rails and a life ring.
Availability in the game
The Seagull is called from berths CG_5 to CG_7 and requires the third rank, with a 300-second cooldown. See [[vehicle-bays]] and [[rockcove-station]].

northwind-opv.title: Northwind OPV
northwind-opv.desc: Offshore patrol vessel, the largest ship of the 3rd Coast Guard Command.
northwind-opv.lead: The Northwind-class offshore patrol vessel is the flagship type of the [[coast-guard-command]]. Two ships serve at Rockcove: CG-301 NORTHWIND and CG-302 STORMRIDER. At about 165 studs they are the largest vessels of Anataria’s coast guard.
sections: Description

Off-white hull with a gray superstructure, a dark red antifouling bottom and the pale orange and navy Coast Guard stripe. On deck are the bow gun with its shield, anchor winch, enclosed bridge with bridge wings, a mast with radar, a funnel, four life rafts and a stern RHIB ramp holding a [[dolphin-rhib]].

Inside, the bridge has the helm console, chart table and captain’s chair; the main deck passage leads to a crew cabin with six bunks, a mess and a sick bay, and a stairway to the engine room.
Availability in the game

The Northwind is called from berths CG_8 and CG_9 and requires the fifth rank, with a 600-second cooldown. Ships are driven through a ship drive system added to the main game on 12 November. See [[vehicle-bays]] and [[rockcove-station]].

sarp-south-shelter.title: Sarp South Shelter
sarp-south-shelter.desc: Deep military bunker cut into the Sarp mountain range, used as an evacuation shelter.
sarp-south-shelter.lead: The Sarp South Shelter is a deep military shelter excavated into the Sarp mountain range at the eastern edge of the region. A long tunnel with a bend, a blast lock and a vehicle hall lead to a main corridor with eleven rooms. During a catastrophe alarm it is the place where the facility’s personnel are evacuated to survive the blast.
facts: Sarp mountain range, eastern edge of the region
Portal with a 24 × 20 stud blast door
Escape tunnel and an 87-stud shaft to a hillside hatch house
sections: Approach and entrance tunnel

The shelter road ends at a portal in the mountainside. Behind the outer blast door a vaulted tunnel runs straight, then bends by about 31 degrees so that the inner blast door cannot be seen from the portal, and runs straight again to the blast lock. The vaulted sections use reinforced concrete with steel ribs every 20 studs; cable trays and color-coded pipes for water, air and fuel run along the walls.
Blast lock and vehicle hall

The blast lock is 44 studs wide and has an inner blast door of the same size as the outer door. Beside it lie a pedestrian air lock, a decontamination room and a guard room. Beyond the inner door is the 100-stud vehicle hall with eight parking bays, large enough for the [[kaya-zma]] to drive in without touching the walls. The 24 evacuation arrival points are in the central lane of this hall.
Main corridor and rooms

A 14-stud corridor leads east from the hall. On the north side are the Command Center, Communications, Infirmary, Dormitory A and Dormitory B. On the south side are the Mess Hall and Kitchen, Generator Hall, Air Filtration Plant, Water and Pumps, Stores and the Armory (whose gate is a decorative closed cage). Doors inside the shelter stay open and the generators, consoles and wells are decoration.
Emergency exit

The emergency exit leaves from the south wall of the vehicle hall. An escape tunnel leads to an 87-stud shaft with a truss ladder and landings, and the shaft ends at a concrete hatch house covered with grass on the hillside, whose door is always open. The exit does not belong to the protected zone, and [[elonya]] forces can infiltrate through it.
Role in the catastrophe sequence
When the evacuation alarm sounds, every volume of the shelter counts as a protected zone. Characters inside it survive the blast; everyone outside is killed. See [[shift-system]].

rockcove-station.title: Rockcove Coast Guard Station
rockcove-station.desc: Naval base on the southwestern bay of Sarpburun, home of the 3rd Coast Guard Command.
rockcove-station.lead: Rockcove Coast Guard Station is the base of the [[coast-guard-command]] on the east shore of a bay southwest of [[skyfortress-4]]. It consists of two levels, an upper terrace with the headquarters and a lower quay with berths for nine ships.
sections: Layout

The upper terrace holds the two-story headquarters, a barracks, a two-bay garage, a helicopter pad, a radar and communications mast and a ceremonial ground, surrounded by a fence with a checkpoint and two watchtowers overlooking the bay mouth. A switchback vehicle road and an enclosed personnel stairway connect it to the lower quay.

The headquarters has a Deployment Hall where the coast guard spawns, a locker area, briefing room and armory on the ground floor and an Operations Center with radar and map displays above. The lower quay has the berths, a fuel pier, a quay crane, a control tower, a workshop and a boat hangar, and a rock breakwater with a green light protects the mouth of the bay.
Berths and ships

Nine berths are numbered CG_1 to CG_9. Berths CG_1 to CG_4 are a floating pontoon for the [[dolphin-rhib]], CG_5 to CG_7 a finger pier for the [[seagull-fpb]] and CG_8 and CG_9 quay berths for the [[northwind-opv]]. Each berth has a post with a panel and a lamp showing whether it is free, in use or blocked, and a gangway that appears only when a ship is present. A harbor terminal on the quay shows the status of all nine berths.
Deployment
Members of the coast guard command always spawn at the Rockcove headquarters. The old garrison spawn was removed on 12 November.
Road
The CoastGuardRoad runs about 1,100 studs west from the main supply road to the station.

sarpburun-air-base.title: Sarpburun Air Base
sarpburun-air-base.desc: Home base of the 132nd Dagger Tactical Squadron with four hardened shelters and a hidden mountain hangar.
sarpburun-air-base.lead: Sarpburun Air Base is the airfield of the [[hancer]] squadron, rebuilt on 10 November on its original site. It has a 2,400-stud runway, a parallel taxiway, four hardened aircraft shelters, a headquarters building and, at the east end of the runway, a hidden hangar cut into the mountain that is reserved for the squadron’s most elite aircraft.
sections: Airfield

The runway is marked with threshold piano keys, numbers 08 and 26, a dashed centerline, touchdown zones and aiming-point blocks. It has white edge lights, green and red threshold lights, an approach light array and PAPI at the 08 end. A parallel taxiway with yellow centerline and blue edge lights is joined to the runway by three connectors, and there are six floodlight masts on the apron.

A control tower, a three-bay fire station with a fire truck, a three-tank fuel farm and two earth-covered ammunition bunkers stand elsewhere on the base. Signs mark the explosives area, and the one gate is protected by a guard booth, a barrier and speed bumps.
Hardened aircraft shelters

Four reinforced concrete shelters, HAS 1 to HAS 4, each 110 studs wide and 150 deep with a vaulted shell and an exhaust stack. Their sliding armored doors are built closed and are opened by the shelter door service: they open automatically when an aircraft is called out of the shelter, or manually from the door controls inside and outside (Dagger members only), and never close while a vehicle or player stands in the doorway. Each shelter has a call panel and a status lamp above the door.

HAS 1 to 3 house the [[k16-alaz]]; HAS 4 is reserved for the [[k21-kaan]]. See [[vehicle-bays]].
Dagger headquarters

The two-story headquarters faces the plaza and the apron. Its entrance hall has a duty desk, a VEHICLE TERMINAL display showing the state of the four shelters, and a commemorative plaque reading 132ND TACTICAL SQUADRON / DAGGER 06 / 17 NOVEMBER 1994 / The watch of those who never returned never ends. A preparation room holds the Dagger locker and a briefing room has a display and benches, and the commander’s office is on the upper floor. The Dagger spawn point is on the plaza.
Mountain hangar

At the east end of the runway a taxi channel lined with retaining walls leads to a concrete portal set into the rock, 180 studs wide and 70 high, with two heavy sliding armored doors and a camouflage net over the top. Behind it is a concrete hall 160 studs wide and 400 long with ribbed ceiling beams and an empty reserved parking area marked in yellow. At least 20 studs of rock cover the ceiling. The portal carries no sign; the facility is secret.
Runway sabotage

If [[elonya]] saboteurs destroy the runway objective, the base’s spawn points close and the call panels refuse to issue aircraft, showing RUNWAY CLOSED, until the sector is reset. Aircraft already in the field are not affected.

karadere-village.title: Karadere Village
karadere-village.desc: Two-neighborhood hillside village around a clock tower square and a monument roundabout.
karadere-village.lead: Karadere is a village on the hinterland roads of [[sarpburun]], laid out as two orderly neighborhoods linked by asphalt streets with sidewalks. Its center is a square with a clock tower, and the crossing of the Karadere and Liman roads is a roundabout with a limestone monument that is also the center of the village’s capture zone.
facts: At least 44, of which at least 10 can be entered
Island radius 9 studs, monument and “KARADERE” plaque
sections: Streets

Eight streets cross the village: D1 to D4 in the East neighborhood and B1 to B4 in the West neighborhood, plus two connecting streets (S0 and E0) from the roundabout. Each has a 14-stud asphalt carriageway with 2.5-stud sidewalks and curbs, with lampposts every 40 studs and crosswalks where streets meet the square and the roundabout.
Houses

Houses stand in orderly rows facing the street, each on a leveled plot, with a stone path from the door to the sidewalk. Their types, facades and roofs are varied, and the enterable ones have an empty, abandoned interior with open or barricaded windows. Olive groves surround the neighborhoods and cypress trees line the streets.
Square and roundabout

The clock tower stands in the middle of the 72 × 70 stud square, facing north toward the capture area, with a fountain, café tables, a plane tree, four benches and three market stalls around it. At the crossing of the two main roads, the roundabout island carries a three-step limestone base with a bronze anchor and laurel wreath and the plaque KARADERE. The monument sits in the middle of the village’s capture area and works as cover.

coast-guard-command.title: 3rd Coast Guard Command
coast-guard-command.desc: Anatarya’s coastal patrol and rescue command based at Rockcove.
coast-guard-command.lead: The 3rd Coast Guard Command is a unit of the Anatarya Coast Guard Command, the body that also operates [[istara]]. It was established in 2029 with the construction of [[skyfortress-4]] and patrols the restricted sea area on the sea side of the facility, intercepts [[elonya]] reconnaissance and landing craft and carries out search and rescue. In the crisis it is the first line of defense on the coast.
facts: Navy blue and white with a pale orange stripe (team color “Storm blue”)
sections: Role in the game

The command is listed under ARMED FORCES in the team selection screen as 3rd Coast Guard Command. Its members always spawn at the Rockcove headquarters and call ships from the nine berths of the station; the Dolphin RHIB needs the first rank, the Seagull FPB the third and the Northwind OPV the fifth. See [[divisions-and-ranks]] and [[vehicle-bays]].
Fleet
The fleet totals nine ships: two Northwind-class offshore patrol vessels, three Seagull-class fast patrol boats and four Dolphin rigid-hull inflatable boats.

shift-system.title: Shift system
shift-system.desc: The continuous 15-minute shift cycle of launch preparation, sabotage and catastrophe.
shift-system.lead: The server of the Skyfortress Military Facility game never ends a match. It runs one shift after another, each about 900 seconds long, until the ŞİMŞEK-III launch window at the end of the shift decides who gains experience. The defenders ([[anatarya]]: soldiers and facility staff) try to prepare and launch [[kartal-7]]; the attackers ([[elonya]]) try to stop the launch, and if they cause a catastrophe the whole facility rushes to the shelters.
facts: T-0 at the end of the Active phase
Armed forces and facility staff of [[anatarya]]
Experience points are saved per player
sections: Shift cycle

Each shift runs through these phases: Briefing (30 seconds, the world resets and players choose a division and spawn), Active (900 seconds), the T-0 decision, Result (20 seconds, announcement and experience awards) and then a new Briefing. If the server is empty the timer waits. A catastrophe can interrupt the Active phase at any moment and leads to a 120-second Alarm, the detonation and a 30-second Lockdown before the world resets completely.
Launch conditions

At T-0 the launch succeeds only if all four conditions hold: 12 of 12 launch checks are done, fuel is at 100 percent, there is no open critical fault and the Launch Control objective (3C) has not been sabotaged. A flawless shift also needs that no critical fault ever occurred and that the hazard level never exceeded 50.
Facility staff duties

Scientists perform launch checks at consoles (a new check opens every minute and takes 4 seconds of holding a prompt). Maintenance crews repair faults in the five systems — pump, generator, cooling, antenna and hydraulics. A minor fault turns critical if left for 120 seconds. Logistics crews, and any defender, carry fuel canisters (10 percent each) from the depots to the launch pad; a carried canister slows the player and is lost if the carrier dies.

Critical faults raise a hazard meter by 0.5 per second each; with none, it falls by 0.2 per second. When the hazard reaches 100 a catastrophe begins.
Attackers and sabotage

The attackers advance through sectors by capturing zones and arming charges. Their sabotage has effects across the shift: destroying the SARP-RAD radar opens the mountain road gate; attacking the power plant halves the interval between faults and darkens launch consoles for 60 seconds; hitting the fuel objective delays T-0 once by 180 seconds and removes 30 points of fuel; sabotaging Launch Control makes the launch impossible and opens the shelter floor; destroying the runway closes the air base’s call panels; and completing objective 3D starts the catastrophe.
Catastrophe

A catastrophe begins either by sabotage or by neglect (the hazard level). The alarm lasts 120 seconds with sirens, red lights and an evacuation indicator toward the nearest shelter; the shelter doors are open. At the end of the alarm every character outside a shelter zone dies, regardless of team. During the 30-second lockdown the shelter doors are closed and nobody spawns; afterwards the doors open, XP is awarded, the world is fully reset and a new shift begins. See [[sarp-south-shelter]].
Experience

Experience points are awarded for tasks: 5 for a launch check or canister, 10 for a repair, 15 for capturing a zone, 20 for arming or defusing a charge. At the end of the shift the defenders receive 100 for a launch (plus 50 for a flawless shift), the attackers 100 for an abort and 150 for a catastrophe, and defenders inside a shelter at the blast receive 20. End-of-shift awards are scaled by how long the player was on the team, with a minimum of 25 percent. XP is saved in a data store, and rank is shown on the player list held with Tab. There is no on-screen shift timer; the launch window is shown only on the display in the Launch Control room.
Teams
Capacity is enforced by the server only: at most 30 attackers and 60 defenders. See [[divisions-and-ranks]].

vehicle-bays.title: Vehicle bays
vehicle-bays.desc: How vehicles, aircraft and ships are called, parked and recalled.
vehicle-bays.lead: Vehicles of the Skyfortress Military Facility game are not found lying around the map; they are called from numbered vehicle bays in the garages, shelters and berths of each unit. A bay panel opens a menu that lists the vehicles the player’s unit may call, with their rank requirements and cooldowns.
facts: Garages, hangar shelters and ship berths
Vehicle Bay prompt, vehicle list, 3D preview, DEPLOY
One vehicle per player at a time
30 seconds without a driver, unless parked
sections: Calling a vehicle

A Vehicle Bay prompt on the panel is shown only to the unit that owns the bay. The menu lists vehicles as AVAILABLE, LOCKED (rank too low), COOLDOWN with a countdown or IN FIELD, and a card shows a rotating 3D preview, top speed, armor, seats, armament, crew and a description. Pressing DEPLOY calls the vehicle; if the player already has one in the field, a second press confirms that it will be recalled. The menu closes when the player walks 15 studs away, dies or changes team.

Each bay has a panel screen and a neon status lamp: green is ready, amber is on cooldown or in the field and red is blocked. The Sarp Guard VEHICLE TERMINAL shows the live state of all six of its bays, and the Dagger terminal shows the four shelters.
Bays and their limits

Sarp Guard garage: SG_1 and SG_3 to SG_6 issue the [[sentinel-lpv]]; SG_2 issues the [[kaya-zma]] (CRAG ACV), with an 8-minute cooldown and only for the Sarp Armored Response Team; the same bay also offers a desert camouflage option.

Iron Fist motor pool: IF_1 and IF_2 issue the [[altai-mbt]] (woodland camouflage option), with a 10-minute cooldown; IF_3 and IF_4 issue the [[taurus-mtv]] MTV-A without limit.

Northern Signal garage: NS_1 issues the [[frost-acv]] (first rank, 300 seconds).

Dagger flight line: DG_1 to DG_3 issue the [[k16-alaz]]; DG_4 (HAS 4) issues only the [[k21-kaan]], requiring the eighth rank with a 600-second cooldown. Aircraft are never called while the runway is closed.

Rockcove harbor: CG_1 to CG_9 issue the [[dolphin-rhib]], [[seagull-fpb]] and [[northwind-opv]]. Ships are moored in their berths and are marked as parked.
Vehicle lifetime

Vehicles are not cleared at the start of a shift, and a vehicle that has been destroyed does not return by itself. A player who calls a new vehicle has all of their previous vehicles recalled. A called vehicle disappears after 30 seconds if no one sits in the driver’s seat (occupants are put out first); the last ten seconds of the countdown are shown in red as DESPAWN IN 0:27. The owner can park the vehicle with P, which shows PARKED and stops the countdown. If someone else sits in the driver’s seat the vehicle becomes theirs, and all of a player’s vehicles are deleted when they leave the game.
Occupied bays
A newly called vehicle automatically removes the vehicle that blocks the bay and puts its occupants out, and pedestrians standing in the bay are moved in front of the panel.

day-night-cycle.title: Day–night cycle
day-night-cycle.desc: The 48-minute cycle of dawn, day, dusk and night with a real sun and moon.
day-night-cycle.lead: The Skyfortress Military Facility game has a shared day–night cycle: every player sees the same time of day, and the sun and moon move smoothly across the sky of [[sarpburun]]. The facility’s outdoor lamps come on at dusk and go off at dawn, except during a power outage.
facts: Two thirds: about 32 minutes of day and 16 of night
sections: Clock

The game day passes in 48 real minutes. Daytime (14 game hours) lasts about 32 minutes and the night (10 game hours) about 16 minutes, so the night passes about 2.9 times faster than the day. Four moments define the look of the sky: night (22:00 to 04:00), dawn (06:00), day (09:00 to 17:00) and dusk (19:45), with transitions between 05:00 and 07:30 and between 18:30 and 21:00. Brightness, ambient light, atmosphere haze and sky color all change with the time; the night is dark but remains playable.
Outdoor lamps

Lamps with no roof within 80 studs above them are outdoor lamps. They turn on from 19:30 and off at 06:15, and during a facility power outage the ones on the facility power grid stay dark even at night. Runway edge lights and vehicle headlights are not governed by the cycle.
Not included
The cycle has no moon phases, weather, seasons or time-dependent gameplay rules.

divisions-and-ranks.title: Divisions and ranks
divisions-and-ranks.desc: The units players can join, their sub-units and the rank requirements for vehicles.
divisions-and-ranks.lead: Players of the Skyfortress Military Facility game choose a division on the team selection screen, which has three columns: ARMED FORCES, FACILITY STAFF and HOSTILES. Each division is a separate team with its own spawn point, uniform and vehicles. Capacity is enforced only by the server and never shown on screen.
facts: 4th Sarp Guard Company · 27th Iron Fist Mechanized Infantry · 132nd Dagger Tactical Squadron · 6th Northern Signal Battalion · 3rd Coast Guard Command
Launch Scientists · Maintenance Crew · Logistics Crew · 18th Doruk Supply Regiment
8th Nereus Naval Commandos · 9th Iris Airborne Brigade
Divisions can be changed every 10 seconds
sections: Armed forces

[[sarp-muhafiz]] protects the facility and has two sub-units: Facility Security and the Sarp Armored Response Team. [[demir-iz]] operates the heavy armor. [[hancer]] flies the aircraft. [[kuzey-isaret]] provides communications and sensing. [[coast-guard-command]] patrols the sea.
Facility staff
The Launch Scientists, Maintenance Crew, Logistics Crew and [[doruk-ikmal]] are the non-military staff who prepare the launch; see [[shift-system]].
Hostiles
The Elonya attackers are [[nereus-komando]] and [[iris-indirme]].
Ranks and vehicle access

Rank is earned with XP. The Sarp Guard rank thresholds are 0, 50, 150, 350, 700, 1,200, 3,000 and 3,500 XP. Joining the Sarp Armored Response Team needs the rank of Guard Captain (3,000 XP); once on the team, anyone can call the CRAG ACV at any rank. Dagger has eight ranks and the top one, Wing Commander, is required to fly the [[k21-kaan]]. In the Iron Fist regiment the fifth rank is Tank Commander, which unlocks the [[altai-mbt]]. The game owner starts at the top rank of every division.
Uniforms and appearance

Division uniforms are issued from lockers: Sarp Guard, Maintenance Crew, Iron Fist, Dagger and Northern Signal sets have been added. A female soldier body is being modeled for players in a separate workshop; it is not yet selectable in the game.
Names and labels
All text the player sees is in English, and unit names use the forms Iron Fist (formerly Demir İz) and Dagger (Hançer). The facility itself is called SKYFORTRESS-4 in the game.

update-log.title: Skyfortress update log
update-log.desc: Development timeline of the Skyfortress Military Facility game, 4–13 November 2026.
update-log.lead: This log lists the main updates to the Skyfortress Military Facility game in order, from the import of this archive on 4 November to the aircraft shelter doors of 13 November 2026. It was compiled from the project’s design documents and progress ledgers.
facts: Separate test place for new vehicles
sections: 4 November
The regional archive was imported (71 entries with a political map) and the vehicle system started with the [[kaya-zma]].
5 November

The [[shift-system]] and the Sarpburun map were designed, with Naramo-style team selection ([[divisions-and-ranks]]). New vehicles: [[sentinel-lpv]], [[taurus-mtv]] and the first [[altai-mbt]]. [[rockcove-station]] and the [[coast-guard-command]] were added, along with Sarp Guard, Maintenance Crew and Iron Fist uniforms, a realism pass on the facility, road junctions and the Kızılsu forest, and map detail phases 1 and 2.
6 November

Altay versions 3 to 6: commander’s cupola, driver station, panoramic sight, woodland camouflage and high-detail turret kit. The [[k16-alaz]] with flight, weapons and damage models, Dagger and Northern Signal uniforms, new R15 animations, a ship damage system, a garrison realism and interior sensor scan, the facility layout and launch terminals.
7 November

[[vehicle-bays]] were added to the main game with ranks, cooldowns and vehicle lifetime rules. [[karadere-village]] was rebuilt in three versions, finishing with the roundabout monument. The [[frost-acv]] was built and the facility was reorganized into four quarters.
10 November

The [[k21-kaan]] stage one, with stealth signature, twin engines and internal weapon bays. [[sarpburun-air-base]] was rebuilt with four shelters and a mountain hangar. The Mission Control interior (20 rooms over two floors) and a wheeled-vehicle torque model were added.
12 November

The [[day-night-cycle]], overhead name tags and a map backdrop were added. The Sarp mountain range closed the east edge of the map with a single canyon pass, and the [[sarp-south-shelter]] was rebuilt as a deep bunker. Coast guard ships can be called and driven, about 120 signs were cleared of obstructions and the facility’s in-game name became SKYFORTRESS-4.
13 November

Aircraft shelter doors that open on demand were added and HAS 4 was reserved for the K-21 KAAN. The [[leopard-2a4-t1]] and the driver-gunner tank crew layout were designed in the workshop, and a female soldier body was started in Blender.
